tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Read backend version, identity, capabilities, read-only mode and operation limits.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the active project; returns zero or one project in this server.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Read metadata of the specified project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project without overwriting any existing project.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an existing project. A different active project must be closed explicitly.

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Close an unused project without silently saving or discarding changes.

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.description: List project files/folders, including programs not loaded in memory.

tools.name: create_project_folder
tools.description: Create a folder inside the specified project.

tools.name: get_import_options
tools.description: Inspect supported import loaders, language/compiler specifications and typed loader options. Optional loader and language/compiler filters show options for a custom import specification; options are keyed by their exact arg names.

tools.name: import_program
tools.description: Import a local binary without overwriting a project file. Returns a job. Optional initial analysis is a separate job.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List all live programs, including background programs, deduplicated across GUI windows.

tools.name: open_program
tools.description: Load a project program in the background and hold it for MCP. Reuses an existing Program; does not open a GUI window.

tools.name: get_program_info
tools.description: Read identity, architecture, hashes, image base, revision, dirty state and GUI/MCP ownership.

tools.name: save_program
tools.description: Explicitly save the selected program and return its saved revision.

tools.name: close_program
tools.description: Release MCP ownership. A program still open in a GUI remains live. Never silently discard unsaved changes.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List functions sorted by address, optionally filtering by name and namespace.

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Find the function containing an address or require an exact function entry.

tools.name: decompile_function
tools.description: Decompile a function by its entry address without changing the program or GUI.

tools.name: disassemble_function
tools.description: Read existing instructions in all ranges of the function body.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List decompiler variables with revision-bound variable IDs for later edits.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List program symbols with their addresses, kinds and namespaces.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List namespaces and classes.

tools.name: list_imports
tools.description: List imported libraries/symbols and local linkage addresses.

tools.name: list_exports
tools.description: List exported symbols and addresses.

tools.name: list_data_items
tools.description: List defined data items, types and bounded values.

tools.name: list_strings
tools.description: List already defined strings with addresses, encoding and lengths.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Find byte patterns in memory. Bounds use [start, end); pattern and mask are hexadecimal strings.

tools.name: get_result_chunk
tools.description: Read another chunk of a cached result from the same program/revision. Text offsets count Unicode code points.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read up to 64 KiB of image bytes. Partial reads return address-qualified chunks and gaps.

tools.name: disassemble_range
tools.description: Read a bounded instruction range without defining code; optional pseudo-disassembly of undefined bytes.

tools.name: list_memory_regions
tools.description: List memory blocks, permissions, overlays, initialized ranges and original byte sources.

tools.name: address_to_file_offset
tools.description: Find all known file-offset mappings for an address; identify unbacked memory explicitly.

tools.name: file_offset_to_address
tools.description: Find addresses backed by a source-file offset. File offsets are hexadecimal strings.

tools.name: get_xrefs
tools.description: Read references to or from an address with source, target, kind and operand index.

tools.name: list_callers
tools.description: List static callsites, including source function and call instruction address; optional explicit cross-program scope.

tools.name: list_callees
tools.description: List static callsites, including source function and call instruction address; optional explicit cross-program scope.

tools.name: resolve_call_target
tools.description: Follow direct/thunk/PLT/external targets and report evidence, ambiguity, cycles or unresolved targets.

tools.name: resolve_import
tools.description: Find candidate implementations of an imported symbol without changing external-library bindings.

tools.name: set_import_library
tools.description: Assign one external location to a named dependency library, creating that library if needed. The reserved <EXTERNAL> library cannot be a target.

tools.name: set_external_library_path
tools.description: Bind an external library to an explicit file in the active project.

tools.name: get_function_cfg
tools.description: Read basic blocks and outgoing CFG edges for a function, including unknown targets.

tools.name: get_pcode
tools.description: Read raw instruction P-code or high decompiler P-code, preserving varnode address spaces.

tools.name: rename_function
tools.description: Rename a function identified by entry address.

tools.name: set_function_prototype
tools.description: Set a function signature in one transaction.

tools.name: rename_variable
tools.description: Modify a variable using its revision-bound ID from list_variables.

tools.name: set_local_variable_type
tools.description: Modify a variable using its revision-bound ID from list_variables.

tools.name: create_function
tools.description: Create a function at an address.

tools.name: delete_function
tools.description: Delete a function definition without deleting its bytes.

tools.name: define_code
tools.description: Explicitly define instructions in an address+length range.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Modify an explicitly addressed label in a namespace.

tools.name: rename_label
tools.description: Modify an explicitly addressed label in a namespace.

tools.name: remove_label
tools.description: Modify an explicitly addressed label in a namespace.

tools.name: rename_data
tools.description: Rename the primary label of a defined data item.

tools.name: set_comment
tools.description: Set a comment; empty text removes it.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Read comments at an address.

tools.name: set_bookmark
tools.description: Set a bookmark at an address.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: List program bookmarks.

tools.name: assemble_instruction
tools.description: Assemble one instruction into bytes without patching memory. Use patch_bytes to apply it.

tools.name: patch_bytes
tools.description: Patch existing image bytes, optionally requiring expected bytes to match first.

tools.name: list_data_types
tools.description: List data types by full category path.

tools.name: get_type
tools.description: Read the complete layout of a data type identified by its full path.

tools.name: create_struct
tools.description: Create a data type at a full category/name path.

tools.name: create_union
tools.description: Create a data type at a full category/name path.

tools.name: create_enum
tools.description: Create a data type at a full category/name path.

tools.name: create_typedef
tools.description: Create a data type at a full category/name path.

tools.name: create_pointer
tools.description: Create or retrieve a pointer data type. Omit size to use the program architecture pointer size.

tools.name: add_struct_field
tools.description: Add a structure field at an explicit byte offset, or append if omitted.

tools.name: edit_struct_field
tools.description: Modify a structure field selected by byte offset or ordinal.

tools.name: delete_struct_field
tools.description: Modify a structure field selected by byte offset or ordinal.

tools.name: rename_struct
tools.description: Rename a structure identified by full type path.

tools.name: delete_struct
tools.description: Delete a structure type and update its references through Ghidra.

tools.name: add_union_field
tools.description: Add a member to a union.

tools.name: add_enum_value
tools.description: Add a named integer value to an enum.

tools.name: delete_enum_value
tools.description: Delete a named enum member.

tools.name: apply_data_type
tools.description: Apply a data type at an address. Existing definitions are replaced only when explicitly requested.

tools.name: create_array
tools.description: Create an array definition at an address.

tools.name: clear_data
tools.description: Clear data definitions in a range without modifying bytes or instructions.

tools.name: get_analysis_options
tools.description: Read available auto/one-shot analyzers, applicability, defaults and typed options.

tools.name: get_analysis_status
tools.description: Read current analysis activity and known previous outcomes; an analyzed flag alone does not prove completion.

tools.name: start_analysis
tools.description: Start an explicit auto or one-shot analysis task without saving the program.

tools.name: start_analysis_batch
tools.description: Start analysis for an explicit list of programs; returns a parent job with independent child outcomes.

tools.name: get_analysis_log
tools.description: Read retained diagnostics and timings for the selected program and analysis job. Omit job_id for the latest job. Immutable cursor pages contain at most 65536 Unicode characters; unavailable history and storage truncation are explicit.

limit.description: Maximum number of text chunks, subject to the 65536-character page cap. Each chunk contains at most 4096 Unicode characters.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List retained MCP jobs with optional program and state filters. Inspect live GUI analysis through get_analysis_status.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Inspect or briefly wait for a job; terminal failure is returned as an MCP tool error.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a job; the response distinguishes requested from completed cancellation.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List CodeBrowser windows and their open programs.

tools.name: get_gui_state
tools.description: Read the selected program, location and selection in a specific CodeBrowser.

tools.name: show_program
tools.description: Show the same live Program in an existing or new CodeBrowser. Does not load a second copy.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Explicitly activate a program/address in a chosen CodeBrowser.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Set address ranges selected in a chosen CodeBrowser.

tools.name: close_program_in_tool
tools.description: Close a program in one CodeBrowser, preserving other owners and requiring explicit discard for the last dirty owner.

tools.name: close_tool
tools.description: Close a CodeBrowser, preserving unsaved programs owned elsewhere and saving its changed tool template by default. Does not save program changes.

save_configuration.description: Save changed CodeBrowser configuration before closing. False rejects changed configuration.
